# DevShed 2.0
DevShed 2.0 makes Xcode cleanup safer, clearer, and much more reliable.
## What's new
- **Preview before cleaning** with real per-item disk usage, so you can see exactly what DevShed plans to remove. - **More reliable Simulator cleanup** for logs, caches, temporary data, and app caches without blindly deleting installed simulator devices. - **More accurate reclaimed-space tracking** based on actual before-and-after disk usage, including partially successful cleanups. - **Cleanup history** with the last cleanup time, what was removed, and how much space each item reclaimed. - **Scheduled weekly cleanup** with configurable day and time, catch-up behavior, and automatic deferral while Xcode or Simulator is in use. - **A much better CLI** installed at `~/.local/bin/devshed`, with preview, targeted cleanup, JSON output, status, and version commands. - **Safer one-click cleaning** with a clearer Safe Clean action and reclaimable-space totals that match what the action will actually remove. - **Update settings fixes** so automatic check/download preferences persist correctly. - **Menu bar UI polish** including a more compact Last Cleanup section and cleaner Settings/Quit actions.
Thanks to everyone who shared feedback on Product Hunt and Reddit. A lot of this release came directly from those requests.
